newsitem.title: GERMANY: One dead, others lost as German building collapses.
newsitem.headline: One dead, others lost as German building collapses.

text.p: German rescue workers on Thursday found one dead woman and said up to seven other people may still be buried under a four-storey house which collapsed after a suspected gas explosion.
Rescuers earlier managed to pull a 60-year-old woman and a 31-year-old man, both seriously injured, from the rubble of the house after they heard knocking sounds.
Police said at least five other people were still missing and hundreds of Red Cross workers, police officers and firemen were at the scene searching for survivors.
Some 15 people were registered as living in the building, but six or seven of them were believed to be away on holiday. The dead woman had not yet been identified.
Residents said the house collapsed at 0100 GMT and they reported hearing a number of explosions. Dozens of windows in the surrounding area were shattered.
Police evacuated surrounding buildings because they suspected a gas leak caused the explosion.
State prosecutors said they had begun investigations into the case, but said nobody knew how the cause of the explosion.
Prosecutor Hans-Rainer Kleinert said he had ruled out the possibility of a racist attack because Germans lived alongside Poles, Portugese and Japanese in the apartment block.
